paper.title: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Task-Assignment with Uncertain Execution Times and Preferences

settings.name_in_paper: Heterogeneous multi-agent sequential task assignment with uncertain rewards, execution times and resource consumption
unmapped: Actions are N x M binary task-to-agent assignment matrices; each task assigned to at most one agent
Tasks block agents for stochastic completion times with support {C_l,...,C_u}; reward observed at task completion (blocking/recurring tasks)
Per-agent expected resource constraint sum_i fbar_im a_im <= L_m with unknown stochastic resource consumption in [0,1]; violation penalty V_T measured separately
Learner knows C_l, C_u and resource capacities L_m
Regret against (1/(1+alpha)) OPT where OPT is the optimal policy with known distributions; alpha is the approximation factor of the assignment oracle
settings.definition_quote: The goal of the planner is to maximize the total expected reward that the team receives over the problem horizon while ensuring that the resource consumption required for any assigned task is within the capability of the agent. ... R^{\alpha}_T = \frac{1}{1+\alpha} OPT - E_{T}

algorithms.name: Bandit Algorithm for Task Assigning (Algorithm 1), exact or (1+alpha)-approximate oracle

symbols.C_l: lower bound on task completion time
symbols.C_u: upper bound on task completion time
symbols.Lbar: maximum number of tasks the team can execute simultaneously
symbols.DeltaL_max: max_m Delta^L_{am}, violation gap of an infeasible assignment (a left implicit in the paper)
symbols.DeltaL_inf_max: max over infeasible assignments a of total violation gap Delta^L_a

conditions: rewards, resources in [0,1]; completion times in {C_l,...,C_u}

source.label: thm:inf_regret_stc_f
source.quote: If $T > MNBC_u$, the violation penalty $V_T$ defined in~\eqref{eq:violation_penalty} for Algorithm~\ref{alg:bandit} is bounded above by V_T \leq \mc O\Big( \frac{C^2_u}{C_l}\ln T + \frac{\bar{L}^2 \ln T}{(\max_{m}\Delta^L_{am})^2} + \bar{L} \max_{a\in \mc A^c}\Delta^L_{a} \Big)

results.notes: Bound on the constraint violation penalty V_T, not regret. The index a in max_m Delta^L_{am} is not bound in the statement.

symbols.C_l: lower bound on task completion time
symbols.C_u: upper bound on task completion time
symbols.Lbar: maximum number of tasks the team can execute simultaneously
symbols.sum_infeasible: sum over infeasible assignments a in A^c
symbols.DeltaL_max_a: max_m Delta^L_{am}, violation gap of infeasible assignment a
symbols.alpha_g: approximation parameter: oracle is (1+alpha)-approximate, regret vs OPT/(1+alpha)

conditions: assignment oracle returns a (1+alpha)-approximate solution, alpha >= 0

source.label: thm:sub_optimal_bound
source.quote: Given that $T > MNBC_u$ and Algorithm~\ref{alg:bandit} is an $(1+\alpha)$-approximate algorithm for some $\alpha \geq 0$, the regret $R^{\alpha}_T$ ... is bounded above by R^{\alpha}_T \leq \mc O\Big(\Big(\frac{1 }{\ul{\Delta}^\alpha } + C_u\Big)\frac{C_u}{C_l^2}NM\ol{L} \ln T +\sum_{a \in \mc A^c} \frac{\bar{L}^3\ln T}{C_l(\max_{m}\Delta^L_{am})^2} \Big)

results.notes: R^alpha_T = OPT/(1+alpha) - E_T; alpha=0 gives exact regret. Recorded as alpha_regret with approximation factor 1+alpha.

bound.expression_latex: \mc O\Big(\frac{1}{C_l} \sqrt{ C_u N M\ol{L} T\ln T} + \frac{C^2_u}{C_l^2}NM\ol{L} \ln T +\sum_{a \in \mc A^c} \frac{\bar{L}^3\ln T}{C_l(\max_{m}\Delta^L_{am})^2}\Big)

symbols.C_l: lower bound on task completion time
symbols.C_u: upper bound on task completion time
symbols.Lbar: maximum number of simultaneously executable tasks
symbols.sum_infeasible: sum over infeasible assignments a in A^c
symbols.DeltaL_max_a: max_m Delta^L_{am}, violation gap of infeasible assignment a

conditions: assignment oracle returns a (1+alpha)-approximate solution, alpha >= 0

source.label: thm:sub_optimal_bound
source.quote: Further, for any distribution of completion times and rewards, the regret is bounded as $R^{\alpha}_T = \mc O\Big(\frac{1}{C_l} \sqrt{ C_u N M\ol{L} T\ln T} + \frac{C^2_u}{C_l^2}NM\ol{L} \ln T +\sum_{a \in \mc A^c} \frac{\bar{L}^3\ln T}{C_l(\max_{m}\Delta^L_{am})^2}\Big)$.

results.notes: Distribution-free in reward/completion times but still depends on resource violation gaps, so it is not fully worst-case.

symbols.C_l: lower bound on task completion time
symbols.C_u: upper bound on task completion time
symbols.Lbar: maximum number of simultaneously executable tasks

source.label: thm:sub_optimal_bound
source.quote: Moreover, when Algorithm~\ref{alg:bandit} is an exact algorithm, for any $N,M,T, L$ such that $T = \Omega(C_u)$, there exists a problem instance for which the optimal regret of any task assignment algorithm is lower bounded by $R^{0}_T= \Omega(\frac{1}{C_l} \min \{\sqrt{C_u NM \ol{L} T}, \ol{L}T\})$.

results.notes: Derived by leveraging Ito et al. (2024) Theorem 4.5. R^0_T = OPT - E_T, where OPT is the optimal expected reward with known distributions.
